## 3. Flagship Projects

### 1. MindFlow — Visual Knowledge & Architecture Graph Platform
- **Period**: September 2026
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Anujanthwal-dotcom/mindflow
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Google Gemini API, LangChain, Prisma, XYFlow, Dagre
- **Key Metrics**:
  - AI Engine: Gemini + LangChain
  - Extraction Uptime: 100% via multi-model fallback cascade
  - Canvas: XYFlow + Dagre automated collision resolution
  - Deep-Dive Latency: < 2s grounded concept exploration
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - Architected an AI extraction pipeline utilizing Google Gemini and LangChain with strict Zod schema validation, parsing complex technical documents and GitHub codebases into connected Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs).
  - Engineered a multi-model fallback cascade (Gemini 3.6/3.7 Flash) and heuristic recovery, ensuring 100% extraction uptime and zero schema violation failures during high-traffic bursts.
  - Integrated an interactive infinite canvas with XYFlow and an iterative Dagre collision-resolution algorithm, resolving multi-node overlaps and dynamically laying out 30+ concept nodes in real time.
  - Built an on-demand concept deep-dive microservice leveraging Google Search Grounding, generating production gotchas, live doc citations, and syntax-highlighted code implementations in under 2 seconds.

### 2. Ticketly — Distributed Ticket Booking System
- **Period**: June 2026 – July 2026
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Anujanthwal-dotcom/Full-Stack-Event-Ticket-Booking-System
- **Stack**: React, NestJS, TypeScript, RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Redis, AWS S3, Stripe, Google Gemini
- **Key Metrics**:
  - Concurrency Defense: Pessimistic Row Locking
  - Cache Layer: ElastiCache Redis
  - Payments: Stripe Webhooks with 3-point verification
  - Search: Natural language query parsing via Gemini
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - Implemented OAuth 2.0 (Google/Facebook) via Passport.js and ElastiCache Redis session storage with session fixation defense.
  - Integrated Stripe PaymentElement with PaymentIntent workflows, webhook handlers, and 3-point verification checks.
  - Built an AI search tool using Google Gemini & LangChain to parse natural queries into filters, with keyword fallbacks.
  - Engineered pessimistic row locking in RDS PostgreSQL to prevent concurrent double-booking under race conditions.
  - Automated post-booking PDF ticket generation (pdfkit), AWS S3 storage, and asynchronous email delivery via Nodemailer.
  - Developed custom in-memory token bucket rate-limiter and cached show listings with automated invalidation.
  - Hardened API security via Helmet, class-validator DTOs, CORS, exception filters, and raw-body Stripe verification.

### 3. NotesBuddy — Notes Sharing Application
- **Period**: February 2026 – March 2026
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Anujanthwal-dotcom/Notes-Sharing-Platform
- **Stack**: TypeScript, React, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Docker, MinIO, ClamAV, Nginx
- **Key Metrics**:
  - File Security: MinIO + ClamAV antivirus integration
  - DB Load Reduction: -40% via in-memory OTP cache
  - Auth Latency: -180ms
  - Deployment: Docker + Nginx on Linux VPS
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - Architected containerized file-management infrastructure via Docker, integrating MinIO object storage, ClamAV malware scanning, and PostgreSQL for secure deployments tested with 50+ beta users.
  - Mitigated database load by 40% using an in-memory OTP cache, reducing auth latency by 180ms.
  - Deployed infrastructure on a Linux VPS, configuring Nginx as a reverse proxy with rate limiting, and hardened server defenses using UFW and SSL certificates.
